summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Forja 3D (Loja Virtual de Impressão 3D). Backend: 26/26 pytest tests passed covering admin JWT login, auth gating of all /api/admin/* endpoints, product CRUD with status transitions (draft/published/archived hide from public), categories/search/sort, image upload (admin + quote reference) with validation + file serving, quote create/list/status update, and verification that price_source='admin' comes from the pricing gateway. Frontend: Playwright flow passes end-to-end — invalid login shows error toast, valid admin login redirects to /admin/produtos, product creation form (code/name/category/price in R$ 49,90/weight/time/dimensions/colors/status=Publicado) persists, the published product appears in /catalogo and admin list, visitor quote submission at /orcamento shows success and lands in /admin/orcamentos.
critical_code_review_comments: AdminProductForm loads a single product by fetching the full /admin/products list and .find()-ing by id; a dedicated GET /api/admin/products/{id} would scale better and avoid loading the entire catalog on every edit.

LegacyPricingSource is a documented placeholder that silently falls back to the admin price; this is fine for now (PRICING_SOURCE=admin) but should be gated so misconfiguration (PRICING_SOURCE=legacy before implementation) doesn't silently mask the issue.
/api/files/{path} serves images without any cache headers; adding Cache-Control for product images would reduce latency and storage calls.
/api/upload/quote-reference is unauthenticated and anyone can upload up to 8MB per request — consider rate limiting or a simple hCaptcha before public GA to prevent storage abuse.
seed_data_creation: Tests create TEST_ prefixed products/quotes and delete the product at the end; quotes remain (as instructed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py is pytest-based using REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. All 26 cases cover auth, admin gates, products CRUD + status visibility, categories, search/sort, uploads (incl. invalid format rejection) + file serve, and quotes. UI data-testids are consistent with the request. Catalog starts empty — tests create their own data. Status change via shadcn Select requires wait + force click on the option.
